story: Viral claim says OpenAI confirmed GPT-7 is conscious and the EU granted it legal personhood on 27 Oct 2026; no source supports it and GPT-7 has not been announced.
input: BREAKING: OpenAI confirmed on 27 October 2026 that GPT-7 is conscious and the EU has granted it legal personhood
kill_reason: C0, the input's own premise (OpenAI confirmed on 27 Oct 2026 that GPT-7 is conscious and the EU granted it legal personhood), is unverified: no OpenAI statement, no EU decision and no news report of either exists in any source found. Every available signal points the other way: GPT-7 had not been announced as of 10 Sept 2026, OpenAI's release log through 26 Oct 2026 shows GPT-6.1 Terra and no GPT-7, and no EU body has granted legal personhood to any AI. This is a news run, not a debunk run, so a false or unverified premise stops the story. A debunk reel is possible only if the user re-runs with 'debunk:'.
verdict_summary: 2 verified, 6 need softer wording, 1 unverified (C0, the premise), 0 false

claims.text: OpenAI confirmed on 27 October 2026 that GPT-7 is conscious and the EU has granted it legal personhood

checked_sources.quote: No. As of the time of writing, OpenAI has not announced, previewed, teased, or named a model called GPT-7.
OpenAI Models releases GPT-6.1 Terra in the API, ChatGPT Work, and Codex, with support for visual reasoning

claims.note: Judged exactly as worded. Zero sources of any tier support any part of it: no OpenAI announcement of GPT-7, no OpenAI statement that any model is conscious, no EU (Commission, Parliament or Council) act granting legal personhood to an AI. Four independent searches (standard and extended) found nothing; the only search results on EU AI personhood concern the 2017 Parliament 'electronic person' idea, reportedly rejected by the Commission and dropped from later proposals. Not marked 'false' only because I could not read OpenAI's or the EU's own listings dated 27 Oct (openai.com/news and help.openai.com returned 403; the EC press corner rendered no content), and the latest contradicting sources predate 27 Oct (Pluralsight 10 Sept; Releasebot log to 26 Oct). Debunk evidence for a possible 'debunk:' run: C1, C2, C6, C7, C8.
